label: East
hint: Central Thai with an Eastern accent
notes: Eastern Thai is close to Central Thai; the difference is mostly accent and a few local words (e.g. Rayong/Chanthaburi). Vocabulary is unchanged here — accent only.
accentHint: Speak Thai with an Eastern Thai accent as heard in Chanthaburi and Rayong: close to Central Thai with a local lilt.

male.th: สวัสดีครับ ไปไหนมาครับ
male.rom: sà-wàt-dii khráp bpai nǎi maa khráp

female.th: สวัสดีค่ะ ไปไหนมาคะ
female.rom: sà-wàt-dii khâ bpai nǎi maa khá
